title: PersonaChatBench: Evaluating Chat Assistants with Diverse Simulated Users
abstract: arXiv:2610.42060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational assistants are expected to help people with diverse backgrounds, preferences, and communication styles. Yet evaluations centered on a single cooperative user provide limited insight into how reliably an assistant serves users with different personas. We introduce PersonaChatBench, a framework for evaluating task competence and responsiveness to diverse user needs. PersonaChatBench pairs the same underlying task with multiple simulated users, each guided by a private persona card that specifies distinct needs, preferences, and interaction behaviors. By holding the task fixed while varying the user, the framework examines how assistant performance changes across user conditions. We evaluate 20 language models across six domains, separately assessing native task outcomes, fulfillment of expressed persona needs, and simulator fidelity. Our results show that task performance and need fulfillment vary across personas and domains

translated_title: PersonaChatBench：使用多样化模拟用户评估聊天助手
translated_abstract: 对话式助手需要为具有不同背景、偏好和沟通风格的人们提供帮助。然而，以单一合作用户为中心的评估方法，对于助手能否可靠地服务于不同角色用户提供的信息十分有限。我们提出了PersonaChatBench，一个用于评估任务能力以及对多样化用户需求响应能力的框架。PersonaChatBench将相同的底层任务与多个模拟用户配对，每个模拟用户由一张私密的角色卡引导，该角色卡规定了不同的需求、偏好和交互行为。通过在保持任务固定的情况下改变用户，该框架考察了助手性能在不同用户条件下的变化情况。我们在六个领域对20个语言模型进行了评估，分别评估了原生任务结果、明确表达的角色需求的满足程度以及模拟器的保真度。我们的结果表明，任务性能和需求满足程度在不同角色和不同领域之间存在差异。
tldr: 提出了PersonaChatBench评估框架，通过将相同任务与具有不同角色画像的多个模拟用户配对，对20个语言模型在六个领域进行评估，发现助手的任务性能和对用户需求的满足程度会因用户角色和领域的不同而显著变化。
en_tdlr: PersonaChatBench is a framework that pairs the same underlying task with multiple simulated users holding distinct persona cards, revealing through evaluation of 20 language models across six domains that task performance and need fulfillment vary across personas and domains.
